title: Teaching himself trumpet and the first three-number band
summary: He had no method; he started on valve trombone, settled on trumpet and learned one number at a time until a small club band could play three numbers all night.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Before World War II? Mm-hmm. I'll be doing time, I'll be doing time of the war. During the time of the war. I see. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. When you studied trumpet, by the way, what kind of method did you use?

I didn't have no method when I first started. Mm-hmm. No, you see I started, I started my, just myself, you know, just, you know, pick up the horn and play, you know. Well, first I started playing on, on trombone. Mm-hmm. First, I was on the key trombone, the valve. Mm-hmm. Then after that, I took the trumpet and different things, sliding trombone, tried that. Then I went back to the trumpet and I just stayed on the trumpet.

Yeah, I liked the trumpet. So after I played the trumpet, then I began to, you know, make scales and practice until I was able to play a number, you know, so, you know what I mean, one number at the time, you know what I mean. Just stay on that one number, just keep playing, keep playing that one number. So after I got that number down really good, then I tried another number, see. Well, eventually, well, I had about three good numbers, you see. So then after we, after I tried the three number, I had three numbers down good. What I did, what we did, then we had a little band, see. So fella, he had a club and we had trumpet, drum, a bass, and a clarinet.
And something else we had, a banjo.

Yeah, we couldn't play no more than three numbers. We played it all night, over and over. Played slow once, then fast the next time, that's what I mean. So the fact that people liked it, you know, them days, they liked it, you know, there was no body kicker, but nothing like that, you know, it was satisfied, you know what I mean. So, well, after that, well, we went on and continued. We never stopped.
Tell him who was in the band, he'd like to know.
